verdict_reason: EuroCropsML (Zenodo, CC BY-SA 4.0) and AI4Boundaries (JRC, EU reuse licence) both fetched and open, but cover only 3 and 7 countries respectively, not EU-wide, undermining the per-country EU framing. CLMS Croplands page rendered no extractable licence/coverage/crop-type text (JS site); whether it is a genuine per-crop-type output vs binary cropland extent is unconfirmed.

sources.name: EuroCropsML
sources.licence_quote: Creative Commons Attribution Share Alike 4.0 International
sources.coverage_quote: Estonia, Latvia, Portugal: 175,906 / 431,143 / 99,634 labelled datapoints respectively
caveats_quoted: Only 3 of 27 EU member states covered (Estonia, Latvia, Portugal) despite the EuroCrops-derived name

sources.name: AI4Boundaries
sources.licence_quote: Reuse is authorised, provided the source is acknowledged
sources.coverage_quote: Austria, Catalonia, France, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Slovenia, Sweden: 7,831 samples, 2.5M parcels, 47,105 km2
caveats_quoted: Ships field BOUNDARY masks, not per-crop-type labels; covers 7 countries/regions of 27 EU states

sources.name: CLMS High Resolution Layer Croplands
caveats_quoted: Page is JS-rendered; fetch returned only the product title, no licence, coverage, resolution or crop-type-vs-extent text could be extracted

ground_truth.label_count_estimate: EuroCropsML: 706,683 labelled parcels, 176 crop classes, but only EE/LV/PT. AI4Boundaries: 2.5M boundary parcels across 7 countries/regions, no crop-type labels.

compute_path.platform: Kaggle free GPU / Colab free tier; direct downloads (Zenodo ~4.8GB, AI4Boundaries FTP)
compute_path.why: Total download ~5GB-scale, parcel/time-series classification, no multi-day GPU training needed

queries.note: WebSearch tool budget exhausted session-wide; used direct WebFetch on known URLs instead

queries.q: CLMS Copernicus Land Monitoring Service crop type high resolution layer

notes: Crux finding: neither named ML-ready source is EU-wide. EuroCropsML = 3 countries (EE/LV/PT), label density varies 4.3x (LV 431k vs PT 99.6k), a real per-country density axis but a tiny country set. AI4Boundaries = 7 countries/regions and boundaries only, not crop labels. CLMS crop-type product existence/coverage unconfirmed after fetch. Raw EuroCrops (not EuroCropsML) covers more countries but was not the named source and was not independently re-verified here.
